name: Queen Succubus no Wana~Tengoku e~
original_name: クイーンサキュバスの罠～天獄へ～
source:
Shortly after the Hero's soul was taken in by the Queen Succubus.........
The Goddess makes her move to take back the Hero.

The Hero who continues to get milked inside the Queen Succubus,
His soul gets connected to the Goddess and she pours holy magic to him.
If he sprays that holy magic imbued semen into the Queen Succubus, he should be able to subjugate her instantly.

......Is he okay with that?　Even though he will never be able taste that pleasure again, if the Queen Succubus were to die?
translation:
勇者的灵魂被魅魔女王夺走后不久……女神开始行动，试图夺回勇者。

勇者仍在魅魔女王体内不断遭到榨取，他的灵魂与女神相连，女神便向他灌注神圣魔力。只要他把蕴含神圣魔力的精液射入魅魔女王体内，应该就能立刻将她降服。

……他真的愿意这么做吗？哪怕魅魔女王死后，他就再也尝不到那种快感了？
